svg.title: the rocket equation
svg.desc: fuel as a share of the full ship mass against the Δv of a leg, for 5 exhaust speeds. marks show the starter legs from the outpost: mars 30.7, mercury 45.2, ganymede 64.7 and icarus 137.1 km/s. at 4.5 km/s every leg needs more than 99% fuel.
svg.text: fuel as a share of the full mass. exhaust speed in km/s.
